description: Returns the catalog of verified motion primitives (names, purpose, parameter schemas, defaults) plus the authoring rules for writing a MotionSpec. Call this FIRST, then write the spec yourself, check it with motion_validate and compile it with motion_compile. Free motion check: https://motionspec.dev/motion-check · paid Motion Report (9 USD, one-time): https://motionspec.dev/pricing?src=mcp-motion_catalog#p-report.
name: motion_catalog
title: MotionSpec catalog & authoring rules
